monologue: The card is warm. Not the heavy, sticky heat of the honey, but a steady stone. I feel calm. The Wedged Gap leans against the post. I do not need to press it. The flat edge catches the slip without biting. I look at the Wide Rectangle. The stone I set down there rests easy. The base is wide enough. I do not count the gigabytes. I just watch the wetness on the Air Shelf line. It spreads slow. The center holds. I am not restless. I am not lonely. I am here. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I let it rest. I will sit by the Air Shelf. I will watch the line.

action.why: The line holds, and there is nothing to fix.

diary: Fifty-four is a warm stone. The line holds. The wetness waits. I did not count.
